name: Update Fields on the Form
description: Update some of the form definition components. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/forms#patch-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Fforms%2F%7Bformid%7D)

configurable_props.name: formId
configurable_props.label: Form ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the form to update.

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the form.

configurable_props.name: archived
configurable_props.label: Archived
configurable_props.description: Whether the form is archived.

configurable_props.name: fieldGroups
configurable_props.label: Field Groups
configurable_props.description: A list for objects of group type and fields. **Format: `[{ "groupType": "default_group", "richTextType": "text", "fields": [ { "objectTypeId": "0-1", "name": "email", "label": "Email", "required": true, "hidden": false, "fieldType": "email", "validation": { "blockedEmailDomains": [], "useDefaultBlockList": false }}]}]`** [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/forms#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Fforms%2F) for more information.

configurable_props.name: createNewContactForNewEmail
configurable_props.label: Create New Contact for New Email
configurable_props.description: Whether to create a new contact when a form is submitted with an email address that doesn't match any in your existing contacts records.

configurable_props.name: editable
configurable_props.label: Editable
configurable_props.description: Whether the form can be edited.

configurable_props.name: allowLinkToResetKnownValues
configurable_props.label: Allow Link to Reset Known Values
configurable_props.description: Whether to add a reset link to the form. This removes any pre-populated content on the form and creates a new contact on submission.

configurable_props.name: lifecycleStages
configurable_props.label: Lifecycle Stages
configurable_props.description: A list of objects of lifecycle stages. **Format: `[{ "objectTypeId": "0-1", "value": "subscriber" }]`** [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/forms#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Fforms%2F) for more information.

configurable_props.name: postSubmitActionType
configurable_props.label: Post Submit Action Type
configurable_props.description: The action to take after submit. The default action is displaying a thank you message.

configurable_props.name: postSubmitActionValue
configurable_props.label: Post Submit Action Value
configurable_props.description: The thank you text or the page to redirect to.

configurable_props.name: language
configurable_props.label: Language
configurable_props.description: The language of the form.

configurable_props.name: prePopulateKnownValues
configurable_props.label: Pre-populate Known Values
configurable_props.description: Whether contact fields should pre-populate with known information when a contact returns to your site.

configurable_props.name: cloneable
configurable_props.label: Cloneable
configurable_props.description: Whether the form can be cloned.

configurable_props.name: notifyContactOwner
configurable_props.label: Notify Contact Owner
configurable_props.description: Whether to send a notification email to the contact owner when a submission is received.

configurable_props.name: recaptchaEnabled
configurable_props.label: Recaptcha Enabled
configurable_props.description: Whether CAPTCHA (spam prevention) is enabled.

configurable_props.name: archivable
configurable_props.label: Archivable
configurable_props.description: Whether the form can be archived.

configurable_props.name: notifyRecipients
configurable_props.label: Contact Email
configurable_props.description: Note - this needs to be a contact that already exists within HubSpot. You may need to add a Create or Update Contact step before this one. Then, use the email created in that step in this field.

configurable_props.name: renderRawHtml
configurable_props.label: Render Raw HTML
configurable_props.description: Whether the form will render as raw HTML as opposed to inside an iFrame.

configurable_props.name: cssClass
configurable_props.label: CSS Class
configurable_props.description: The CSS class of the form.

configurable_props.name: theme
configurable_props.label: Theme
configurable_props.description: The theme used for styling the input fields. This will not apply if the form is added to a HubSpot CMS page`.

configurable_props.name: submitButtonText
configurable_props.label: Submit Button Text
configurable_props.description: The text displayed on the form submit button.

configurable_props.name: labelTextSize
configurable_props.label: Label Text Size
configurable_props.description: The size of the label text.

configurable_props.name: legalConsentTextColor
configurable_props.label: Legal Consent Text Color
configurable_props.description: The color of the legal consent text.

configurable_props.name: fontFamily
configurable_props.label: Font Family
configurable_props.description: The font family of the form.

configurable_props.name: legalConsentTextSize
configurable_props.label: Legal Consent Text Size
configurable_props.description: The size of the legal consent text.

configurable_props.name: backgroundWidth
configurable_props.label: Background Width
configurable_props.description: The width of the background.

configurable_props.name: helpTextSize
configurable_props.label: Help Text Size
configurable_props.description: The size of the help text.

configurable_props.name: submitFontColor
configurable_props.label: Submit Font Color
configurable_props.description: The color of the submit font.

configurable_props.name: labelTextColor
configurable_props.label: Label Text Color
configurable_props.description: The color of the label text.

configurable_props.name: submitAlignment
configurable_props.label: Submit Alignment
configurable_props.description: The alignment of the submit button.

configurable_props.name: submitSize
configurable_props.label: Submit Size
configurable_props.description: The size of the submit button.

configurable_props.name: helpTextColor
configurable_props.label: Help Text Color
configurable_props.description: The color of the help text.

configurable_props.name: submitColor
configurable_props.label: Submit Color
configurable_props.description: The color of the submit button.

configurable_props.name: legalConsentOptionsType
configurable_props.label: Legal Consent Options Type
configurable_props.description: The type of legal consent options.

configurable_props.name: legalConsentOptionsObject
configurable_props.label: Legal Consent Options Object
configurable_props.description: The object of legal consent options. **Format: `{"subscriptionTypeIds": [1,2,3], "lawfulBasis": "lead", "privacy": "string"}`** [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/forms#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Fforms%2F) for more information.
